title: Fix incorrect relative imports in ConfigPanel.stories.tsx
body:
Storybook build fails with Rollup `handleInvalidResolvedId` — `ConfigPanel.stories.tsx` lives in `src/stories/` but imports siblings with `./` instead of `../`, resolving to nonexistent paths.

```diff
-import { ConfigPanelRenderer } from './custom/config-panel-renderer';
+import { ConfigPanelRenderer } from '../custom/config-panel-renderer';
```

Fixed all 4 imports (`config-panel-renderer`, `config-field-renderer`, `use-config-draft`, `config-panel` types) to use `../` relative paths.
